description: This file contains the implementation of a journaled grain for seat reservations using Orleans framework, including the grain class, state class, and reservation class.

classes.name: SeatReservationGrain
classes.description: A journaled grain managing seat reservations with event sourcing.

classes.name: ReservationState
classes.description: Represents the state of seat reservations within the grain.

classes.name: SeatReservation
classes.description: Defines a seat reservation with seat number and user ID.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Handles reservation requests by enqueuing an event and confirming its propagation.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a reservation to the current state, respecting first-writer-wins conflict resolution.
